description: This file defines a React component for an auction item detail page, including data fetching from a database, real-time updates via subscriptions, and bid placement logic. It handles displaying item details, current highest bid, and bid list.

methods.name: ItemDetailPage
methods.description: React functional component that displays details of an auction item, manages real-time bid updates, and handles bid submission.

methods.name: handlePlaceBid
methods.description: Handles the user submitting a new bid, performs optimistic UI updates, and communicates with the backend to record the bid.
